limitations_and_boundaries: CROP-seq is demonstrated only for a small-scale proof-of-concept screen; scalability to genome-wide libraries requires further validation.
gRNA assignment confidence depends on number of detected genes per cell; low-quality cells may be unassigned.
Potential cell doublets can lead to multiple gRNA assignments, though excluded from analysis.
Validation performed in Jurkat cell line; generalizability to other cell types not shown.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
